cross_dataset.note: window model alone at a 0.5 cut (not the hybrid detector). MAWI: real benign traffic to the busiest destinations of trace 200803181400, with or without the trace experiment attacks injected; synthetic_test: 300 runs of the shipped model test seed (1007)

protocol.dataset: CIC-DDoS2019 (Sharafaldin et al., ICCST 2019), packet captures
protocol.ingress: IPv4 packets entering 192.168.50.0/24 from outside it
protocol.labels: attack = source 172.16.0.5, the only source of every attack-labelled CSV flow; attack type = CSV label whose time range contains the packet; attack second = attack machine sent >= 100 packets that second
protocol.limitation: one attack source address and light benign traffic: tests detection, flow classification and collateral damage on real traffic, not separation of many attack sources

transfer_to_synthetic.note:
P4 with the shipped scorer vs with the CIC-trained scorer on synthetic traffic (both with the
    shipped detector; no flows there, so no P4+L3). Evaluation only: nothing is fitted or chosen here.
    Seeds: realistic test seed 2001 and the first seed of each safety scenario (as in safety_experiment).
